title: The Stand
author: Stephen King
summary: A military-engineered flu wipes out most of humanity. The survivors begin to dream of two figures, an elderly woman in Nebraska and a dark man in Las Vegas, and slowly gather on one side or the other.
readIf: you want a sprawling, character-heavy apocalypse novel that mixes everyday survival with a battle of good and evil.
skipIf: you want a short book or find a pandemic setting difficult to read about.

pairings.reason: A calmer, literary post-pandemic story that cares about what survives of art and community.
A bleak, stripped-down vision of the collapse of civilisation.
Another survival story about a community in a sealed, post-collapse world.
